text:
Noah: Quick sync 1: reworking the compact metrics tile for the console. Main tradeoffs: legend density vs footprint, tick label wrapping/rotation, unit badges, smoothing controls, and how to show extreme values. Posting prototype link and config. Thoughts?

Priya: Love the smaller tile. Quick flags: when legend is inline it eats the chart area on narrow viewports. Could we use a collapsible chip list instead? :chip:

Jorge: Collapsible chips sound good. Maybe show up to 4 inline then "+{n}" that opens a panel with checkboxes. Keeps visual context while saving vertical space.

Quinn: For keyboard users, the "+{n}" must be focusable and open a panel with role=listbox. Also ensure Shift+Tab moves back into chart elements.

AccessibilityBot: Accessibility notes:
- Collapsible chip panel: role=dialog with aria-modal=false, manage focus on open, restore focus on close.
- Ensure contrast of chip text >= 4.5:1.
- Use clear aria-labels for unit toggles (e.g., "Units: bytes SI").

Noah: Good call. Axis ticks: prototype uses truncated labels with ellipsis at >6 chars and a rotated 45deg option for dense x-axes. Any preference?

Priya: I prefer rotation for time-series with readable dates, truncation for long categorical labels. If rotated, increase hit area for hover.

Jorge: Units: proposal is a per-chart badge in the top-right of the tile (e.g., "SI") that opens a micro-menu: Auto / Raw / SI / Human. Defaults come from chart metadata. Tooltip also displays full unit.

Quinn: Make the unit badge keyboard-accessible and expose a shortcut (U) to cycle units. Screen readers should announce the current unit once per chart load, not per tick.

Noah: Smoothing: current team preference has been a small exponential smoothing by default. Complaints that spikes get washed out. Options: toggle smoothing in the micro-menu, and show an inline "raw on hover" overlay for the tooltip.

Priya: Could we provide a lightweight smoothing slider (0-100%) in advanced view? Default 25%. Also add a small tilde icon in legend items for smoothed series.

Jorge: Raw-on-hover is handy. UX idea: when tooltip opens, draw raw-point markers and a dashed line for raw series; keep smoothed line for baseline. Annotate tooltip with "raw value" and timestamp.

Noah: Outliers: current implementation clamps at 99.5 percentile and shows a tiny caret at the axis top with "overflow" count. Concern that clamping hides distribution. Alternative: show whisker to percentile and caret that expands to full-range view on click, plus a modal listing top outliers.

Quinn: Agree on expand-on-click behavior. Export: ensure CSV and APIs return raw values regardless of display clipping. Document this in release notes.

AccessibilityBot: Outlier handling accessibility:
- Caret/overflow marker needs role=button and an aria-describedby that references the modal content.
- Modal listing outliers should be navigable with screen reader and keyboard, include data context (timestamp, raw value).

Noah: Here's the small config snippet I'm testing in the prototype: 

```json
{
  "legendStyle": "chip-collapsible",
  "legendPreviewLimit": "4",
  "unitPreference": { "default": "auto", "allowed": ["auto","raw","si","human"] },
  "smoothing": { "method": "exponential", "defaultAlpha": "0.25", "perSeriesControl": true },
  "outlierStrategy": { "display": "whisker_plus_overflow", "percentile": "99.5" }
}
```

Priya: Tiny copy nit: change "whisker_plus_overflow" to "whisker_overflow" in the API for brevity. Also rename `legendPreviewLimit` -> `legendPreviewCount`.

Jorge: UX nit: when the chart auto-scales after expanding overflow, animate smoothly to the new y-axis so users don't get lost.

Quinn: Also ensure keyboard users can trigger the expand with Enter/Space when overflow marker is focused and Esc to collapse.

Noah: Decisions proposed:
1) Legend: chip-collapsible with 4-preview + expandable panel (keyboard accessible).
2) Units: per-chart badge with micro-menu, default from metadata, shortcut to cycle.
3) Smoothing: exponential default 0.25, per-series toggle + raw-on-hover overlay.
4) Outliers: whisker to percentile + overflow caret opening detailed list + expandable full-scale view.

Priya: +1 approve.

Jorge: approve :+1:

Quinn: approve, will file accessibility checklist PR with focus flows and ARIA roles.

Noah: Thanks folks 1. I'll update Figma screens (link: https://www.figma.com/file/wxyz9876/compact-tiles) and post the follow-up once I push the fig updates. Adding a note to the release draft about CSV behavior.

AccessibilityBot: Reminder: include ARIA attribute examples and keyboard shortcuts in the engineering handoff doc.

Noah: Will do. Closing thread after fig updates.
